Corollary
[Isometry group] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0213 ↗ thm:chow-iv-mostow-rigidity 1. ch31:31.51\group Mostow rigidity

The isometry group of a finite-volume hyperbolic manifold of dimension at least three is finite and isomorphic to $\operatorname {Out}(\pi _1(\mathcal H))$.
